title: Building Products Like a Chief Engineer
primary_theme: Earliest-Stage Technical Risk and Venture as a Service Business
founder_lessons: Talk to the right earliest-stage investors before the idea is fully locked, especially when technical risk is central.
Communicate what is truly special without giving away the crown jewels.
Use a teaser deck to give investors enough context to assess fit before a meeting.
Remember that even excellent technology and strong entrepreneurs can fail when the strategic landscape is unwinnable.
community_organizations: School in 12 GB, district Sri Ganganagar
notable_quotes: it is never too early for me. It is often too late.
I'm in the service business. I am here to help an entrepreneur achieve their vision, build a great company
think very carefully about how you are going to communicate what you are doing without giving away the crown jewels.
